questions.question: Dr. Karim receives a patient with an ALD (Long-Term Condition). Dr. Nadia reminds him of the ticket modérateur exemption procedure. According to Article 9 of Law 65-00, what is the rule?
options: Exemption is automatic without formalities
A prior request must be sent to CNSS with the ALD certificate
Exemption is decided by the dentist themselves
The patient must pay and then get reimbursed
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Article 9 provides for exemption from the ticket modérateur for ALD, but CNSS must be informed in advance.' Dr. Karim: 'I will send the certificate to CNSS before treatment.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must prepare an invoice for a patient benefiting from AMO. Dr. Karim advises her to check the agreed tariffs. According to Article 8 of Law 65-00, which care is excluded from reimbursement?
options: Emergency care
Aesthetic surgery and alternative medicine
Basic dental procedures
Radiological examinations
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Article 8 clearly excludes aesthetic surgery and alternative medicine from the scope of AMO.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will check that the procedure is not excluded.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim has a patient who has changed managing body. Dr. Nadia advises him to check the registration. According to Article 32 of Law 65-00, to what condition is the opening of entitlement to benefits subject?
options: Approval by a consulting physician
Prior payment of contributions due
Agreement of the Ministry of Health
A six-month waiting period
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Article 32 specifies that the opening of entitlement is subject to prior payment of contributions.' Dr. Karim: 'I will check my patient's situation.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia receives a patient whose spouse recently passed away. Dr. Karim reminds her of the dependents' rights. According to Article 35 of Law 65-00, for how long do dependents continue to receive benefits?
options: For a period of six months
For a period of two years
For a period of five years
Until the end of the dependents' lives
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Article 35 provides for a two-year retention of rights for dependents of the deceased insured person.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will inform my patient of her rights.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim finds that a patient has received care abroad. Dr. Nadia asks him to check the reimbursement conditions. According to Article 13 of Law 65-00, which benefits abroad are reimbursable?
options: All benefits without conditions
Only in case of unexpected illness or lack of appropriate care in Morocco
Only for patients on business trips
No benefits abroad are reimbursable
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Article 13 allows reimbursement in case of unexpected illness during a stay, or when care cannot be provided in Morocco with prior agreement.' Dr. Karim: 'I will check for prior agreement.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia receives a 22-year-old university student patient. Dr. Karim asks her to verify their dependent status. According to Article 5 of Law 65-00, up to what age is an unmarried child pursuing higher education covered?
options: Up to 21 without condition
Up to 26 upon proof of studies
Up to 30 for higher education
Until degree completion without limit
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'The age limit is extended to 26 for unmarried children pursuing higher education, upon justification.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will ask for their school certificate.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must declare a procedure to CNSS. Dr. Nadia advises him to use the information system. According to Article 10 of Law 65-00, in what form can certain items such as devices be reimbursed?
options: In the form of per-procedure reimbursement
In the form of a lump sum defined by regulation
In the form of full reimbursement
In the form of variable reimbursement depending on the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Article 10 specifies that devices and medical equipment are reimbursed as a lump sum.' Dr. Karim: 'I will apply this lump sum.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia has a patient who wishes to add their parents to their insurance. Dr. Karim reminds her of the extension conditions. According to Article 5 of Law 65-00, on what condition can the insured person request extension to their parents?
options: Automatically without additional contribution
Provided they pay their contribution
Only if parents are over 70
Extension to parents is never possible
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Article 5 allows extension on condition that the insured person pays their parents' contribution.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will inform them of this condition.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim receives an ANAM audit notification. Dr. Nadia advises him to prepare. According to Article 26 of Law 65-00, what is the purpose of the medical control exercised by the managing bodies?
options: Control the quality of the practice's equipment
Verify the conformity of prescriptions and identify abuses
Verify the number of patients treated per day
Control the bank accounts of providers
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The control aims to verify the conformity of prescriptions, the validity of benefits, and to identify abuses and fraud.' Dr. Karim: 'I will prepare my files.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia notices an anomaly in a patient's reimbursement. Dr. Karim advises her to contact CNSS. According to Article 24 of Law 65-00, what sanction can be imposed on a provider for non-compliance with the agreement?
options: A flat fine of 10,000 dirhams
Removal from the agreement for a determined period
Definitive suspension of their professional practice
A simple warning
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'ANAM may decide to place a provider outside the agreement for non-compliance with the terms of the agreement.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will check that I comply with the agreement.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim has a patient who lost their AMO rights after ceasing activity. Dr. Nadia asks him to check the rights retention deadlines. According to Article 34 of Law 65-00, how long does a person retain their rights after ceasing to meet the conditions?
options: A maximum period of six months
A period of two full years
A period of only one month
No period of rights retention
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Article 34 provides for retention of rights for a maximum period of six months after cessation of conditions.' Dr. Karim: 'I will inform my patient of this deadline.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must establish an agreement with a patient for long-term treatment. Dr. Karim reminds her of the principles of the national agreement. According to Article 19 of Law 65-00, with whom are national agreements concluded for the private sector?
options: With the national councils of professional orders
With patient unions
With private insurance companies
With the Central Bank of Morocco
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Agreements are concluded between the managing bodies and the national councils of the relevant professional orders.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will rely on this national agreement.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim receives a patient who was a victim of a traffic accident. Dr. Nadia advises him to check AMO coverage. According to Article 6 of Law 65-00, how is risk managed in case of a third-party accident?
options: The patient must bear all costs
The managing body exercises legal recourse against the third party
The dentist bears the total financial loss
The law prohibits any claim for reimbursement
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The law allows recourse against the responsible third party to recover the costs incurred.' Dr. Karim: 'I will refer my patient to CNSS.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must bill a non-contracted procedure. Dr. Karim advises her to clearly inform the patient. According to Article 25 of Law 65-00, what is the obligation of the contracted dentist regarding patient information?
options: The patient must know the agreed tariffs
The patient must be informed of non-agreed tariffs
The secret is kept by the doctor
Information is not mandatory
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Transparency is mandatory, especially for non-agreed procedures that remain at the patient's expense.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will provide them with a detailed estimate.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim has a patient who benefits from ticket modérateur exemption. Dr. Nadia asks him to check the list of ALDs. According to Law 65-00, which conditions are eligible for exemption?
options: All conditions without distinction
Serious or chronic conditions listed by decree
Only acute conditions
Only dental conditions
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The law provides a limited list of conditions eligible for total or partial exemption.' Dr. Karim: 'I will consult the official list.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia finds that her assistant is not registered with AMO. Dr. Karim reminds her of the employer's obligations. According to Article 131 of Law 65-00, what is the penalty for non-registration of an employee?
options: A flat fine of 5,000 dirhams
A fine of 1,000 dirhams for each employee concerned
A suspension of the right to recruit
A prison sentence of 3 months to 1 year
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Article 131 provides for a fine of 1,000 dirhams for each unregistered employee.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will immediately regularize the situation.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim receives a patient who was hospitalized. Dr. Nadia advises him to check coverage for hospital care. According to Article 7 of Law 65-00, what types of care are guaranteed by AMO?
options: Only curative care and hospitalization
Curative, preventive, rehabilitation, maternity, and dental care
Only aesthetic care
Exclusively medications
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Article 7 lists preventive, curative, rehabilitation, maternity, dental, orthodontics for children, etc.' Dr. Karim: 'I will check the complete coverage.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia receives a patient who does not have an insurance card. Dr. Karim advises her to check their registration number. According to Article 9 of Law 65-00, what is the rule regarding the portion remaining at the insured person's expense?
options: The insured person cannot take out complementary insurance
The insured person remains free to take out complementary insurance
The remaining portion is always covered by the State
The ticket modérateur is prohibited by law
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Article 9 specifies that the insured person remains free to take out complementary insurance to cover the remaining portion.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will inform them of this possibility.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim has a patient who has taken out complementary insurance. Dr. Nadia asks him to check the coordination with AMO. According to Article 11 of Law 65-00, what are the reimbursement methods provided for by law?
options: Only per procedure upon presentation of invoices
Per procedure, by pathology, by global allocation, or by capitation
Exclusively by lump sum per homogeneous disease group
Only by capitation with a referring physician
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Article 11 provides for several methods: per-procedure reimbursement, lump sum by pathology, global allocation, prepayment, or capitation.' Dr. Karim: 'I will apply the appropriate method.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must declare a dental imaging procedure. Dr. Karim advises her to check the nomenclature of procedures. According to Law 65-00, are imaging procedures included in dental benefits?
options: No, imaging is always outside the scope
Yes, if necessary for diagnosis of care
Yes, only for patients under 10 years old
No, only surgical procedures are included
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Technical procedures include radiological examinations necessary for diagnosis.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will include imaging in my declaration.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim receives a patient whose CNSS reimbursement was refused. Dr. Nadia advises him to appeal this decision. According to Article 24 of Law 65-00, to whom can one appeal in case of refusal of coverage?
options: The Ministry of Health
The ANAM appeals commission
The Council of the Order of Dental Surgeons
The Court of First Instance
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The ANAM appeals commission is competent to examine appeals against decisions of managing bodies.' Dr. Karim: 'I will help my patient refer to this commission.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must bill care to a patient with a mutual insurance. Dr. Karim advises her to respect the agreed tariffs. According to Article 23 of Law 65-00, what are the obligations of the contracted dentist regarding tariffs?
options: Apply the tariffs set by the national agreement
Apply free tariffs at the dentist's choice
Apply reduced tariffs for AMO patients
Apply increased tariffs for mutual insurance patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Compliance with agreed tariffs is an obligation for any contracted dentist.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will ensure I apply the correct tariffs.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim receives a patient who has never been registered with AMO. Dr. Nadia advises him to refer them to CNSS. According to Article 9 of Law 65-00, is AMO registration mandatory?
options: No, it remains optional depending on the contract
Yes, for any person exercising an activity
Yes, only for the public sector
No, except in cases of confirmed serious illness
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The obligation to register is the foundation of AMO for any person exercising an activity.' Dr. Karim: 'I will refer my patient to CNSS.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia has a patient who received long-term treatment. Dr. Karim advises her to check the reimbursement ceiling. According to Law 65-00, how are care coverage limits set?
options: They are set by the practitioner's free choice
They are defined by nomenclatures of procedures
They depend on the total annual contribution amount
They are decreed by medical associations
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'The nomenclature sets the reference tariffs for procedures and their coverage limits.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will consult the nomenclature before treatment.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim, after managing several complex ALD files, receives congratulations from Dr. Nadia. What is the next step for Dr. Karim?
options: Become a reference in AMO agreement
Retire
Change specialty
Forget good practices
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Mastery of complex files is a valuable skill. Becoming a reference in agreement is the next step.' Dr. Karim: 'I will train in advanced AMO file management.'
